rationale: Band shift of the Phase 1 spectrum, N(+0.061, 0.004) eV: posterior of the fit to HPLC spectra of the isolated pigment (Williamson et al. 2020).
Oscillator-strength scale incl. glucoside -> phenol-equivalent units, log-normal (median 39.5, sigma_ln 0.057): posterior of the fit to the measured S6 extract MAC (Williamson et al. 2020).
Gaussian band FWHM, N(0.621, 0.005) eV: posterior of the HPLC-shape fit.
Mean glacier-algal biovolume per cell, N(2320, 542) um^3: mean and SD over 180 S6 surface-ice samples (Williamson et al. 2020 counts), truncated at 400 um^3.
Cylinder length/diameter, U(1.46, 2.37): between the mean ratios of A. alaskanum and A. nordenskioeldii populations (Prochazkova et al. 2021, Table 2).
Intracellular phenolic concentration N(22.0, 8.7) kg m^-3: phenolics per cell (mean, SD over 53 samples) / pooled S6 biovolume (Williamson et al. 2020); truncated at 0.5.

Intracellular concentration ~ V^gamma, gamma ~ N(-0.73, 0.73) (jackknife SE): maximum-likelihood fit of phenolics per cell vs biovolume per cell over 64 S6 samples (Williamson et al. 2020); gamma = 0 is equal concentration in both species.

Specific surface area of bubbly bare ice, ln SSA ~ N(-0.972, 0.348): 19 measurements (Cooper et al. 2021 Greenland; Dadic et al. 2013 micro-CT), studies weighted equally; converted to BioSNICAR's bubble radius at the bottom-layer density.
Weathering-crust density, U(330, 560) kg m^-3: measured range at S6 (Cooper et al. 2018).
Algal abundance, log10 B ~ N(3.56, 0.78): 180 S6 surface-ice samples with cells > 0 (Williamson et al. 2020 counts).
Surface mineral-dust mass mixing ratio, log-normal (median 307 ug/g, sigma_ln 0.47), moment-matched to the measured S6 loading 342 ug/g, relative SD 0.49 (Cook et al. 2020).
Bulk clear-sky transmissivity N(0.919, 0.036): 2301 clear-sky hours at PROMICE KAN_M (June-August, all years).
Fraction of pigment complexed with Fe, N(0.494, 0.040) on [0, 1]: posterior of the fit of the measured Fe-purpurogallin increment (Prochazkova et al. 2025) to the S6 extract MAC (tier D only).
